powers.actor_raw: the assessor of the county of Nassau
powers.action_summary: Accept a retroactive real property tax exemption application from Bais Torah U'tefillah BTU for the 2015 and 2016 rolls.

powers.action_summary: Grant the exemption and correct the rolls, upon approval of the Nassau county legislature.
